text: I feel the sterile quietness of modernity in the first space—a meeting room behind glass, empty and waiting, as if suspended between moments of purpose. In the second, I am drawn to the vivid energy of ideas—R+D, research and development, growth made visible through art and language. I am energized by the promise of innovation, yet faintly alienated by the abstraction of it all. Here, I am an observer on the threshold between sterile anticipation and creative possibility.
